acceptedInterpretation: Implement a provider-free M2 launch-readiness layer only: bind approval/snapshot/task/runner readiness artifacts, keep Phase 1 provider execution and outcome data out of scope, and preserve ③-before-⑥ sequencing for future M2-a execution.
notes: This resolves the potential collision between solving launch blockers and prematurely running Phase 1. The accepted interpretation clears static readiness blockers but leaves execution-derived blockers pending until real provider execution.
